description.en: Mailgun private API key: key- then thirty-two lowercase hex characters. Restricted to hex on purpose: the wider alphanumeric form matches any key- prefixed identifier, and hex is what Mailgun emits. A bare thirty-two hex run without the prefix is not covered, because it is also an MD5 digest and a Twilio SID.
